text: The Reserve Bank of Australia raises its cash rate 25 basis points to 4.6%, its fourth increase of 2026 and the highest level in 15 years. Inflation remains above the 2%-3% target band, while the RBA retains further rate increases within its policy range.

meta.note: Forward policy optionality is retained only as a stated boundary condition.

text: Oura postpones its planned Nasdaq IPO after formally launching the offering process on Sept. 21. The proposed sale covered 50 million shares and up to $2.2 billion. Oura remains privately held and reports profitability alongside 90% expected FY2026 revenue growth.

meta.note: The offering is postponed rather than withdrawn permanently.

text: Alaska expands premium seatingn across Alaska and Hawaiian fleets while reducing total seats on Hawaiian A330s. New premium-economy, lie-flat suite and dedicated lounge capacity spans both brands, which remain separately operated.

meta.note: Fleet, lounge and loyalty changes share one premium-capacity configuration but span multiple operating surfaces.
